firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi everyone,

I received an email that pretends to come from Kaggle Staff and asks me to hand over my full submission code. It's a scam. I'm posting so that nobody else sends their code to this person.

What the email says (screenshot 1)

Sender: "Bovard-Doerschuk-Tiberi (bovarddd)"
Subject: "Verification required for your recent submission in Kaggriculture"
It claims that "near-identical submission patterns" were found between your account and another participant's. It asks for your "complete codebase, including scripts, within the next 48 hours", or you will be "disqualified from prize eligibility".

Why it's fake

• Fake account (screenshot 2): https://www.kaggle.com/bovarddd. Its profile says "Joined 6 hours ago", it has no bio and no competition history, and it copies the real staff member's name, photo, job title and location.
• Real Kaggle staff account (screenshot 3): https://www.kaggle.com/bovard. It joined 14 years ago and has the "Kaggle Team" label.
• The email was sent from a personal free-mail address, not from Kaggle.
• The real staff account name is bovard. The fake one adds "ddd" at the end: bovarddd.

If you get the same email

• Do not reply and do not send any code or files.
• Report the fake profile on Kaggle (the "⋮" menu on the profile → Report) and forward the email to Kaggle support.
• If you're unsure whether a message really comes from Kaggle, check the sender's profile (join date, "Kaggle Team" label) and look for an official post on the competition's discussion page.

Our team members code is our own work, and it would be a shame if anyone lost theirs to this kind of trick. Stay safe, and good luck in the final days!
